prompts.baita:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input image is the exact approved RIGHT-FACING battle sprite base. Create an animation key-pose sheet of THIS SAME character, absolutely identical face identity, hair, clothing layers, equipment, colours, proportions, simplified hard-edge anime painting, camera angle and RIGHT-facing battle direction. Character head/nose and gaze always look toward SCREEN RIGHT, torso/hips oriented RIGHT, no camera-facing poses. Real drawn changes of pose and weight, no duplicated static images. One transparent landscape image 1536x1024, strict uniform THREE columns by TWO rows (six equal 512x512 cells), ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom. EACH cell contains exactly ONE complete full-body character with props, using same scale in every cell. Neutral body height about 70% of cell height, identical floor line 91% of cell height. 8% clear transparent margins inside every cell; no silhouettes cross cells or touch borders. No lines, boxes, dividers, text, numbers, captions, watermark, background, vignette, haze, smoke, soft backdrop glow or floor shadows. All empty space alpha=0. Use antialiased sharp character boundaries. Keep hair tails and weapons completely visible and same length in all cells. No arbitrary costume changes, extra limbs, props floating away, or off-frame weapon tips. In moving attack preserve front-foot plant with natural back-heel lift and weight transfer; do NOT individually resize figures to fill cells.
Action sheet: Six ATTACK key poses, she stays SEATED on the SAME fixed chair facing right, closed lap book and two floating books retain the same exact design: (1) anticipation: upper body leans slightly back, hands gather above lap book, eyes right; (2) windup: right/forward hand draws toward chest, one open floating book tilts forward; (3) FAST release: torso leans toward right, forward hand thrusts open palm toward RIGHT, short SMALL clean gold spell streak attached to palm; (4) impact: arm fully extended toward RIGHT, direct clean small gold geometric light at palm, no huge effect obscuring figure; (5) follow-through: arm lowers slightly, light disappears, shoulders relax; (6) recovery: hand returning toward neutral position above book, matches base proportion. Chair, shoes and lap book do not change scale. Whole chair and both floating books visible in every cell, no background magic circle.
